description_sq:
Te Zogu i Zi, shume prane rrethrrotulimit, shesim 1+1 perfekt per investim.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 7 te nje pallati te sapo perfunduar me 2 ashensore dhe organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale, tualet dhe nje ballkon shume te bollshem ne te cilin kane dalje te dy ambientet e apartamentit.
Pallati ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje ndertim shume cilesor me fasade te ventiluar dhe punime cilesore. Zona eshte nje nga zonat me te mira te Tiranes me te gjitha faciletet, si bar kafe, supermarkete, shkolla, akses me Qendren e qytetit etj.
Apartamenti eshte shume i pershtatshem per investim pasi kerkesa per qira ne kete zone eshte shume e larte!
Per me teper informacion ose nje vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni!
description_en: In Zogu i Zi, very close to the roundabout, we are selling 1+1 perfect for investment. The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a newly completed building with 2 elevators and is organized in a living room together with a kitchen, a double bedroom, a bathroom and a very spacious balcony to which both rooms of the apartment have exits. The building in which the apartment is located is a very high-quality building with ventilated facades and quality works. The area is one of the best areas of Tirana with all facilities, such as coffee bars, supermarkets, schools, access to the city center, etc. The apartment is very suitable for investment as the demand for rent in this area is very high! For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
